title: ConQEC: Concolic Testing for Quantum Error-Correcting Code Implementations
abstract: arXiv:2610.31443v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum error-correcting code (QECC) implementations are hybrid software-control systems: measured syndromes drive decoder dispatch, recovery actions, and logical checks. Existing QECC verification techniques can prove formal obligations, and general quantum testing can expose final failures, but developers still lack a scalable testing workflow that generates concrete faults and explains where a QECC repair path first diverges. This paper presents ConQEC, to our knowledge the first concolic testing framework for QECC implementations. By combining concrete (Pauli) fault replay with symbolic repair-path constraints, ConQEC generates tests that expose not only final logical failures but also fault--syndrome--decoder--recovery (FSDR) diagnostics: the injected fault, observed syndrome, decoder decision, recovery action, oracle result, and earliest divergent stage. translated_title: ConQEC：面向量子纠错码实现的具体-符号混合测试
translated_abstract: 量子纠错码（QECC）实现是一类混合的软件-控制系统：测量得到的症状驱动译码器调度、恢复操作以及逻辑校验。现有的QECC验证技术能够证明形式化义务，通用的量子测试也能暴露最终的故障，但开发者仍然缺乏一种可扩展的测试工作流，能够生成具体的故障并解释QECC修复路径最初在何处发生分歧。本文提出了ConQEC，据我们所知，这是首个面向QECC实现的具体-符号混合测试框架。通过将具体的（泡利）故障重放与符号化的修复路径约束相结合，ConQEC生成的测试不仅能暴露最终的逻辑错误，还能提供故障-症状-译码器-恢复（FSDR）诊断信息：包括注入的故障、观测到的症状、译码器决策、恢复操作、预言机结果以及最早发生分歧的阶段。其针对泡利故障、症状谓词、译码器与恢复的符号编码……
tldr: 本文提出ConQEC，首个面向量子纠错码实现的具体-符号混合测试框架，通过结合具体泡利故障重放与符号化修复路径约束，不仅能暴露最终逻辑错误，还能生成故障-症状-译码器-恢复（FSDR）全链路诊断，定位修复路径最早发生分歧的阶段。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ConQEC, the first concolic testing framework for quantum error-correcting code (QECC) implementations, which combines concrete Pauli fault replay with symbolic repair-path constraints to expose not only final logical failures but also fault–syndrome–decoder–recovery (FSDR) diagnostics that pinpoint the earliest divergent stage of the repair path.
